svg.title: keyguard: recall and precision on 714 planted fake keys
svg.desc: Horizontal bars from zero to 100 percent, 714 planted fake keys, 549 of them covered by some engine's rules, and 227 lookalikes planted to trip precision. The first row labels its three bars: recall on the covered plants, recall on all plants and precision. betterleaks: recall 99.8% on the 549 covered plants, 79.7% on all 714, precision 97.3%; gitleaks: recall 88.7% on the 549 covered plants, 73.7% on all 714, precision 96.4%; trufflehog: recall 70.7% on the 549 covered plants, 60.5% on all 714, precision 89.2%; all three engines: recall 100% on the 549 covered plants, 88% on all 714, precision 91.1%; API Key Crawler pipeline: recall 100% on the 549 covered plants, 98.7% on all 714, precision 97.4%. Beside the bars, a field of 714 dots stands for the planted keys (549 of them lit as covered) and a field of 227 rings for the lookalikes. A thin crawler, small glowing dots joined by hairlines, walks a git-log rail along the bottom edge and reaches a hairline out to the end of each of the pipeline's three bars.
